trigger: The originally specified native SGD learning rate 0.005 was unstable; the first step changed a coordinate by 0.0383977842 and had update norm 0.378238371. The curve SGD arm was also unstable. All original results are retained as an oversized-step stress test.
change: Add a second native/curve SGD pair using the same 24 batches. Set the constant learning rate from the initial training gradient so its maximum first-step coordinate update is 2e-5, the maximum possible first Adam update at the predeclared learning rate.
selection_boundary: The trigger included observed instability in training and evaluation. The replacement rate is computed from the training gradient, not a search over held-out scores. The same validation set is reused; this is a disclosed stability control, not an independent confirmation study.
budget: 48 additional Pythia steps; 168 total. No other hyperparameter tuning. The original protocol is unchanged and its hash remains valid.
interpretation: Stable-regime equivalence and unstable-regime numerical divergence are reported separately. Native versus curve SGD at 0.005 is not evidence of an intrinsic representation incompatibility.
